description: Physical computing and networking equipment: laptops, desktops, monitors, servers, peripherals, printers, network devices.
Software licences, subscriptions and SaaS tools (per-seat or annual), including renewals and support for software.
Cloud infrastructure usage, internet / leased lines, mobile and telephony, hosting, managed IT and IT support services.
Stationery and consumables used at desks: paper, pens, files, toner and ink, small office items.
Running and maintaining office buildings: housekeeping, security, repairs, AMC for building equipment, furniture, office rent.
External expert services: audit, legal, tax, consulting, certification and advisory fees.
Promoting the company: digital ads, media buying, agencies, events, printed collateral, branded merchandise.
Employee business travel and client entertainment: flights, hotels, cabs, trains, visas, meals with clients, offsites.
Moving goods: couriers, domestic and international freight, customs clearance, warehousing and 3PL.
Direct materials that go into manufactured products: metals, polymers, chemicals, yarn, components.
Maintenance, repair and operations items for factories and plants: safety gear, tools, spares, lubricants, fasteners.
Electricity, water, gas and fuel bills for sites; diesel for generators; power purchase agreements.
People-related spend: recruitment, staffing, background checks, learning and training, employee benefits and insurance.
Food and beverages for employees and events: cafeteria, pantry supplies, meals, snacks, drinking water.
Materials used to pack and ship products: boxes, cartons, films, tapes, pallets, labels, containers.
